definitions: The part of something that is left over after other parts have been taken away, used, or dealt with.
The number that is left when one number is divided by another and the first number is not an exact multiple of the second.
The people or things that are left after some have been removed or dealt with.
examples: He ate some of the cake and gave the remainder to his friend.
When you divide 7 by 3, the remainder is 1.
Some guests left early, but the remainder stayed for the whole party.
